measurement: stats ingest, release build, streaming from disk
protocol: bench-spec.md §2 (3 runs, median, first cold run reported separately). Peak RSS sampled at 100 ms by harness/run-bench.ps1.
fixture: bench/harness/gen-stats.mjs — 1500 assets, 200 chunks, modules with embedded source strings. Identifiers made unique after the first generator draft reused 400 of them, which silently deduped the graph (154,379 vs the real 445,602 keys).

runs.verdict: memory passes (346 MB), wall time misses by 0.6 s (3628 ms vs 3000 ms) — recorded as missed, not retargeted

regression_found_and_fixed.what: the first CLI read the whole file with std::fs::read before parsing
regression_found_and_fixed.cause: the file size lands on the memory floor before a single module is parsed; 1 GB input became 6.4 GB resident
regression_found_and_fixed.fix: core::stats::ingest_reader over a 1 MiB BufReader (ingest_file), with a 512 KiB head read used only for artifact sniffing
regression_found_and_fixed.lesson: the memory story is a property of the IO path, not of the parser. A benchmark that only measures parse time would have missed this entirely.
